title: Open locus of negative Ext vanishing for a pseudo-coherent complex against a relatively perfect one, with affine finitely presented Hom space

statement_spans.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-complexes-open-neg-exts-vanishing (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 5153-5182

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: two preliminary observations: pseudo-coherence and relative perfectness survive base change, and Ext groups over fibres base change along field extensions, so the vanishing in (1) depends only on the point y of |Y|; over affine Y a universally computing pseudo-coherent L identifies the negative-Ext vanishing locus with a cohomology jump locus of L, open by the jump-loci lemma; etale descent from an affine cover gives openness on general Y; parts (2) and (3) reduce to W = Y, where the claim Rf_{V,*}RSheafHom(K_V, E_V) has no negative cohomology sheaves follows etale locally from L sitting in degrees <= 0, giving (2) via the Ext-to-cohomology identifications; for (3) the simplicial-spaces lemma makes F an fppf sheaf, representability and affineness/finite presentation are etale local, and over affine Y the two-term representative of L exhibits F as the fibre product identifying it with a linear fibre product of affine spaces over Y (source lines 5184-5319)

core_obligations: Observations (proof lines 5185-5201): pseudo-coherence and relative perfectness survive base change; Ext over fibres tensors with field extensions, so the vanishing in (1) is a property of the point y in |Y|.

Affine case of (1) (proof lines 5203-5224): the universally computing L identifies negative Ext vanishing with H^i(L x^L kappa(y)) = 0 for i > 0; jump loci give the open W, universal for all field-valued points.
General Y for (1) (proof lines 5226-5234): W pulls back to the open W_i on an etale affine cover, hence W is open; parts (2), (3) reduce to W = Y.

Part (2) (proof lines 5236-5269): Ext^i over X_V = H^i(V, Rf_{V,*}RSheafHom(K_V, E_V)); etale locally with affine Y, L sits in degrees <= 0 so RSheafHom(L_V, O_V) sits in degrees >= 0, giving the claim and the vanishing for i < 0.

Part (3) (proof lines 5271-5318): the simplicial-spaces lemma (footnote: Cech fppf hypercovering) makes F an fppf sheaf; representability, affineness, finite presentation are etale local; over affine Y the two-term representative exhibits F(V) as a kernel, i.e. a fibre product of affine spaces over Y.
proof_roadmap: Establish the two base-change/stability observations (proof lines 5185-5201).
Prove (1) on affine Y via the universally computing L and jump loci, then descend etale locally (proof lines 5203-5234).
Prove (2) by the vanishing claim on Rf_{V,*}RSheafHom, checked etale locally via L (proof lines 5236-5269).
Prove (3): fppf sheaf property, etale-local reduction, affine presentation as a fibre product (proof lines 5271-5318).
